title: Vanilla and sandalwood wax melt
subtitle: A warm, woody wax melt for oil burners and electric warmers
excerpt: A soy wax melt scented with vanilla fragrance oil and sandalwood essential oil. Melted in an oil burner or electric wax warmer, it releases a warm, woody, sweet scent. Smaller than a candle batch, wax melts use no wick and melt at lower temperatures. Makes about 12 wax melt portions. Shelf life 12 months.
sourceNotes: Wax melt formulation: soy wax is the standard base for wax melts (no wick required; lower melt point = more scent released at warmer temperatures). Fragrance load for wax melts: higher than for candles, 12-15% is standard for wax melts because there is no flame to manage. Vanilla fragrance oil: vanillin + supporting sweet/warm notes; more robust heat stability than vanilla absolute or EO. Sandalwood EO (Santalum album or Santalum spicatum): woody, dry, persistent; excellent fixative quality, extends the life of the vanilla note. Poured into silicone clamshell moulds or ice cube trays; snapped out once set. Wax melt portions: approximately 10-12 g each, 12 portions from 130 g total.

recipe.batchNotes: Wax melts store well, make a large batch (500 g of wax) and stock up for gifting season. Store in sealed bags to preserve the scent.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Ready to use once set (2 hours). Package in cellophane bags to preserve the scent.
recipe.shelfLifeNotes: 12 months. The scent fades fastest when exposed to air, keep in sealed packaging. The wax itself is stable indefinitely.

glossaryTerms.definition: A wickless scented wax designed to be melted in a warmer rather than burned. Wax melts release fragrance at lower temperatures than candles and can be swapped out when the scent fades.

An ingredient that slows the evaporation of lighter, more volatile scent compounds. Sandalwood essential oil is a classic fixative, its own dry, woody note persists and extends the duration of the blend.

content.text: Melt the soy wax over a simmering-water bath to 75°C. Never leave melting wax unattended.
Cool to 60-65°C. Stir in the vanilla fragrance oil and sandalwood essential oil.
Pour into the silicone mould. Leave undisturbed for 2 hours until fully set. Pop out the wax melt portions and store in sealed cellophane bags.

Place one portion in the dish of a wax warmer or oil burner (tea light type). Do not leave a tea light burner burning unattended. The scent lasts 6-8 hours per portion; swap in a fresh portion when the fragrance fades.
12 months in a sealed bag in a cool, dark place. The scent fades if left exposed to air. The wax itself does not deteriorate.
